Yes, both parts feel right. Selecting "Archive" in the side navigation took me to a view holding just my set-aside things — with that "Set aside, not lost" heading, it reads exactly like a safe holding place rather than a trash can. And using "Restore" on the old typography reference clearly sent it back to All Bookmarks, with a little confirmation and the counts adjusting so I could see it had returned home.

So the archive has its own proper place, and getting something back out of it is easy and obvious. That's the "set aside without losing, and change my mind later" behavior I wanted. Happy with this.

One thing I'll want to be sure of when it all comes together — since the whole point of archiving is to get things out of the way — is that archived items stay out of my normal list and everyday searches unless I deliberately go look in the Archive. But I expect that's the intent, and I'll confirm it when I see the finished thing.
